description: Their investments split by region - US, UK, Europe, Asia, emerging markets and global - in pounds and as a share of all their investments, with the biggest holdings in each, their own share of joint accounts, and a global fund split by its factsheet where one is added. The same split as the Region chart on their Overview. Use for 'how much of my money is in the US, Europe or Asia', 'where in the world are my investments', or how much an election or market move abroad touches them.
name: get_regions
title: Investments by region
